en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a riverside town with a bridge over the river, several boats and barges along the quay, and red-roofed buildings at the water's edge. A wooded hill rises behind the town, topped by a church-like building. The printed caption at the bottom reads "Gruss aus Meissen. Martinsberg." and there is a red handwritten number "384" in the top right margin. Along the left border is vertical publisher text.
